_readme: The starter tag cache. Committed on purpose, and it contains no personal
data: every key is a generic English phrase and every value describes what
a kind of photograph looks like. Nothing here came from anyone's library.
Keys are NORMALISED prompts - NFKC, casefolded, internal whitespace
definition; a key that is not in that form will simply never be hit.
Why it is committed: the same prompt must yield the same tags forever, so
that a memory built today rebuilds identically next year and a dismissal
keyed on the prompt keeps working. It also means a contributor with no API
key, and CI with no network, still get a working feature.
These entries were written by hand rather than generated, following the
same rules the model is given: a distinctive visual description, no event
name, no year, no person, no place. Add your own the same way, or let the
model write one and copy it out of your data directory.
